text:
Ravi: DeployBot flagged degraded embedding quality for v5.0.0 in eu-west-1 canary. auto-rollback suggested. Thoughts?
DeployBot: [auto-rollback recommended] Signal: embedding cosine dist drift > 0.12 for top-10 queries. Confidence medium. Action: rollback to v4.5.2 in 3m unless overridden.
Elena (platform): this is regional only. global latency fine. we should avoid global rollback — can we split traffic by region and pin eu to older model?
Tom S: agree. targeted rollback/pin for eu-west-1 only. we have routes feature. command: `deployctl pin --region eu-west-1 --to v4.5.2 --duration 1h`
Support Lead: if we pin eu, notify customers in EU on the 99% list. small chance of semantic differences, include note in support ticket.
Ravi: execute targeted pin, cancel auto-rollback. Elena, can you run post-pin sanity checks for embeddings?
Elena (platform): running now. `deployctl pin --region eu-west-1 --to v4.5.2 --duration 1h` -> applied.
DeployBot: auto-rollback canceled due to manual pin.
Elena (platform): sanity checks: sample queries show cosine diff back within baseline across 500 samples. KV cache behavior normal.
Tom S: updating routing config to ensure dedicated customers in EU are on pinned model too.
Support Lead: notifying affected customers and updating ticket: "Temporary regional pin applied to mitigate embedding regression; investigating. No data loss."
Ravi: creating follow-up issue for runtime: add region-aware model gating so DeployBot recommends targeted actions next time.
DeployBot: created issue RB-2079: region-aware rollback recommendations.
Ravi: closing thread for now; reopen if eu metrics degrade.
